title: Research history as therapy: a novel interdisciplinary framework for meaning-making and well-being
core_idea: Proposes History Therapy (HT), an interdisciplinary framework that integrates curated historical knowledge and cases with psychological and philosophical approaches to facilitate deep self-reflection, exploration of identity, and new forms of meaning-making to support personal transformation and psychological well-being.
tldr: Introduces History Therapy, a method that uses exposure to alternative historical worldviews in a structured, replicable way to catalyze self-reflection and meaning-making, intended for individuals seeking deeper self-knowledge and for therapists/coaches expanding practice.
